description_en: Updates a role in a workspace
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace update-workspace-role --workspace-id 83000 --role-name dev-test --module-permissions example-string --role-id role-dhg0000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWorkspaceRole

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom role. The name must be unique within the workspace. It can be up to 64 characters long and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 自定义角色名称。同一个工作空间名字不允许重复。支持字母、数字、下划线_、中划线-，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: role_name

element_fields.help_en:
The module name. Valid values are:

- PaiDesigner: PAI-Designer

- Paiflow: workflow

- DSW: PAI-DSW

- DLC: PAI-DLC

- Dataset: dataset

- Model: model

- Image: image

- CodeSource: code source

- PaiWorkspace@@Workspace: Basic workspace information

- PaiWorkspace@@MemberRole: workspace member management

- PaiWorkspace@@Resource: workspace computing resource management

- PaiWorkspace@@Config: workspace configuration center

- ArtLab: ArtLab
element_fields.help_zh:
模块名。可取值：
- PaiDesigner：可视化建模（Designer）
- Paiflow：工作流
- DSW：交互式建模（DSW）
- DLC：分布式训练（DLC）
- Dataset：数据集
- Model：模型
- Image：镜像
- CodeSource：代码配置
- PaiWorkspace@@Workspace：工作空间基本信息
- PaiWorkspace@@MemberRole：工作空间成员管理
- PaiWorkspace@@Resource：工作空间计算资源管理
- PaiWorkspace@@Config：工作空间配置中心
- ArtLab：ArtLab
element_fields.name: module_name

element_fields.help_en:
The permission type. Valid values are:

- ReadOnly: read-only access.

- ReadWrite: Allows users to edit and run.

- FullAccess: full control.

- NoPrivilege: no permissions.

- CustomPermissions: custom permissions
element_fields.help_zh:
权限类型。取值如下：
- ReadOnly：只读
- ReadWrite：可编辑/运行
- FullAccess：完全控制
- NoPrivilege：无权限
- CustomPermissions: 自定义权限
element_fields.name: permission_type

element_fields.help_en:
The access type. Valid values are:

- PUBLIC: All members in the current workspace can perform this action.

- PRIVATE: Only the creator can perform this action.

- ANY: Both the creator and non-creators can perform this action
element_fields.help_zh:
访问类型，可能值：
- PUBLIC：当前工作空间所有成员都可以操作。
- PRIVATE：只有创建者可以操作。
- ANY：创建者和非创建者都可以操作
element_fields.name: accessibility

element_fields.help_en:
The entity access type. This parameter is ignored if `Accessibility` is set to `PUBLIC`. If `Accessibility` is set to `PRIVATE`, the value of this parameter determines the permissions. Valid values are:

- CREATOR: Only the creator can perform this action.

- ANY: Both the creator and non-creators can perform this action
element_fields.help_zh:
存取类型。 当 Accessibility 为 PUBLIC，所有用户都能操作，此值无效； 当 Accessibility 为 PRIVATE 时，根据 EntityAccessType 的值决定权限，EntityAccessType 支持如下值：
- CREATOR：只有创建者可以操作。
- ANY：创建者和非创建者都可以操作
element_fields.name: entity_access_type

element_fields.help_en: The permissions. This parameter is required and applies only when `PermissionType` is set to `CustomPermissions`
element_fields.help_zh: 权限列表。仅PermissionType为CustomPermissions时才有效，且必填
element_fields.name: permissions

parameters.help_en: The permission settings for the role
parameters.name: module_permissions
